noAccess.title: Not part of your role
noAccess.body: Your role in this business does not include this page. If you need it, ask an owner or an admin.
noAccess.planBody: This business's plan does not include this page. The business's owner can change the plan.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address. The link may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

notifications.browserNote: This browser does not pop notifications up yet — they arrive in the bell at the top of the page.

location.denied: This browser is blocking location for this site. Allow it from the icon beside the address, then try again.

workCalendar.removeBody: {{date}} becomes an ordinary working day again, and payroll counts it as one.
workCalendar.oneWorkingDay: At least one day a week has to be a working day, or payroll would have nothing to divide by.

upload.pick: Choose a CSV or Excel file, or drop it here
upload.pickChange: Click, or drop another file, to change it
upload.wrongType: That is not a CSV or Excel file. Choose a .csv or .xlsx file.
upload.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files — a month or two each.

plan.contact: To change the plan or pay for more branches, write to
plan.contactUnset: To change the plan or pay for more branches, contact {{appName}}.

counter.doneBody: The bill is saved in this browser. Hand the token to the customer.
counter.noMenuYet: No menu is saved in this browser yet. Connect to the internet once to load it.
counter.attentionBody: The server refused these bills. They stay in this browser until somebody deals with them.
counter.readOnly: The plan has ended, so no new bills can be taken. Bills already taken stay in this browser until it is renewed.
counter.noPrinter: No receipt printer is set up in this browser.
counter.storageUnavailable: This browser is not keeping data — a private window, or site data blocked — so no bill can be taken here. Open the counter in a normal window.
counter.saveFailed: The bill could not be saved in this browser, so no token was given. Try again.

sync.offline: Offline — {{count}} bill saved in this browser, sent when the connection is back
sync.offline_plural: Offline — {{count}} bills saved in this browser, sent when the connection is back
sync.blocked: {{count}} bill kept in this browser — the server is not taking new bills right now
sync.blocked_plural: {{count}} bills kept in this browser — the server is not taking new bills right now

printer.subtitle: How this browser prints each token
printer.methodBluetoothHint: Chrome or Edge sends each token to the printer paired with this computer or phone, and it prints by itself.
printer.methodDialogHint: Any browser, any printer this computer has. The print dialog opens for each token.
printer.unsupportedSerial: This browser cannot reach a Bluetooth printer. Use Chrome or Edge, or print through the print dialog.
printer.insecureSerial: Bluetooth printing works only on {{appName}}'s secure (https) address.
printer.pairHint: Pair the printer once in this computer's or phone's Bluetooth settings (the PIN is usually 0000 or 1234), then choose it here.
printer.chosen: A Bluetooth printer is chosen in this browser
printer.kioskTip: To print without the dialog each time, make the receipt printer this computer's default and start Chrome with --kiosk-printing.
printer.testDialog: The sample token is in the print dialog. Check the slip fits the paper.
